purpose: Select one global effective precooler-duty multiplier after correcting active-fill segmentation, refitting the tank model, and calibrating the dispenser flow-area multiplier. Use only the previously declared Tables Method development cases.
prohibited_evaluation_inputs: the eight consumed MC Default external holdout fills
candidate_range_rationale: The superseded v1 development search selected its upper bound of 8.0. The v2 range was expanded before evaluation to determine whether a finite interior optimum exists after the parser, tank-fit, flow, and nominal-pressure corrections.
parameter_mapping: Multiply hydrogen-to-coolant UA and chiller UA by the same global factor; retain coolant thermal capacity.
tie_break_rule: Choose the smaller multiplier when objective scores are equal within 1e-12.
post_selection_rule: The selected multiplier may be used for model development and internal comparison only. It cannot rehabilitate or be retested as a new validation result on the consumed MC Default holdout.
claim_limit: An effective duty multiplier is a global calibration parameter, not identification of physical heat-exchanger or chiller hardware.
